correctness.rationale: PASS: The source primary Hardy–Stein and weighted Hilbert identities give N_{s,t}(1+h)^t=1+(t²/4)||h||_{s,2}²+O_t(||h||∞ ||h||²_{s,2}) for |h|≤1/2. Taylor of power 2/t yields quadratic form (p/2)(||h||²_{alpha,2}-(beta/alpha)||h||²_{beta,2}) with uniform O((||h||∞+||h||²_alpha)||h||²_alpha) remainder. Monomial orthogonality gives λ_k, ratio c_alpha(k+1)/c_beta(k+1) relative = (alpha+k)/(beta+k)<1, λ_1=0 and λ_2=p/2*(beta-alpha)/(beta+1)>0, increasing to p/2. h=t z² makes sharp local ratio. The common automorphic isometry and real implicit-function theorem kill first derivative under local modulation; scope is local only and requires both norm smallness hypotheses. Independent rational test alpha=2/5,beta=4/3,p=3/2 produced gap 3/10, λ1=0, λ3=213/500 and strict increasing modes; finite test not all-parameter proof.
